Ka jingbuhai Shnong Daog myosbuwa eh ha ka por bym pat don jingthob jingtar ria ka ri Mawloog la shn iathuh-khana pateog la pateng da ka ktieo, mynmlet myn* miet haba ki briew ki la iaium sawdong ban ia ayaid diog habar laa; hapoh tiog poh sem yada ki la lah bam ja bam jbur. U riew tymmea bapdeng jong kl u jo ia- tbub ia kl jingiatbuh-khana ia ka pateog la pateng, na u kpa ha u kbun bad oa kawei ka pateog aha kawei pat. La ai kyrteog “Mawloog" ia kane ka shnong, namar ka long ka shnong kaba dap da ki mawlong>mawteb kiba beh. La don ka Jingiatbub kbaoa pateng ba ha kane ka shnong la wan sbong shnong U Bnang (U Ramhah ba ki tbaio Ri War). Lne u Bnang uba la wan oa sha ki thaio Lawbah • Sheila bad la ka jong ka kmie kaba la tymmsn bad u la wan sbong shnong ba Mawloog shi por. Ha kioe ki kbyndiat por u la leh sbibun kiei kiei kiba la pynsab jiogkyoniaw ia u hadub kine ki sogi. Ha ka por tlang haba ka kmie jong u ka khriat eh, u ia leit kit da kl mawbah>mawsan khnaog ban pyosyaid sogi ia la ka jong ka kmie. U la buh uwei u mawbah ba Mawkhen ia la khot kyrteog u kbiieb>Mawkbeo. U la bub sa uwei pat u mawbah ba Umbublang ia uba la khot kyrteng o kblieh- Umbuhiaog.

Ki don bun tylli ki mawbah^mawsao bid ki jingpynkylla ia ki lum ki wab, kiba la tip kum ki mawka* wang simtung, ka Jynsuh U Bnang, Mawshamok bad kiwel kiwei. Kumta namar ka jingbuo eb ki mawbab-mawsan ha kane ka shnong la khot kyrteog ia ka ka "Mawloog'*. Ha ki spab snem sbuwa ka jingwao ki Pbareng aba Ri Kbasi, ka Hima Mawloog ka daog long, kaba dap da ki lawbah'lawsao, ki rai-eb ki rai*dam, ki mawloog^ mawteb bad* ym shym la don surok ne lynti syogkieo kiba thikna kumba long myota. Ka kbyodew ka la long, kaba bha bad ba-seisoh sbibun ia ka baa rap. K«ne ka jinglong jong ka jaka ka la ring shib.aa.ia fc|n.nog^ ^i. ban wan skud jaka bad ban rep. BUanId MMiswai kiba la wan na shapbang mihngi, nyngkpag 9k ki lb abong shnong ba dong Mawlong (Mawloog ksopafj.i' Hwgi^ [2] KA JINGBUHAI SHNONO DC ki la sdaog ban rep ban riang bad tei ia ki kut kiba skhem ban iada iaiade na ki nongshun. Ki la long ki briew kiba koit ba khiab bad kiba stilur. Kat aba* ba ki leit ki rab la ki wait ki sum, ka ryntieb u kbnam bad ka Stieb. Hadien katto katne por, ynda baba kl la nangroi bad nangbun briew ki la ia sdang ban iapra sba ia ki jong ki jong ki dong. Don napdeog jong ki kiba ia leit sbong sba Diengsiar, sba Mawsymkot bad sba Noogkdait. Kane ka Nongkdait ka la long kbam pajib na Mawlong bad la ker kut ia kaoe barob sawdong da ki them bad ki Ibub suda. Don bun ki krem ki krob ba kaba ki briew ki pyodonkam ia ki kum ki jaka rieb. Ha kane ka jaka la don ka krem Pubon kaba pei lyogba nadub Ktong baduh Lad Umrin. Dei na kaoe ka krem ba ki briew ki pyndookam ia ka kum ka lyoti leit lew leit Hat, leit bri ieit bsab.

Haba kut kaoe ka Krem ba Lad Umrin, la don u«ei u maw uba beb uba la sboa kboaog ban tap ia kaoe ka krem tad ypda ki la wan jingwao. Ki oog baoa baba ki noogsbun ki wan ban biar tbma ia ki kim lab satia ban ithub ia ka lynti ban rung sha« pob sbooog. Ki briew ba kaoe ka jaka ki sboogsuk shoogsaio namar ki noogsbun na sfaabar kim ju lab ban « an rung. Ki im ka jiogim kaba kmeo bad basogewbba barob sbi katta. Kumba jo long ka dustur sbooog, ki briew sbi* sieo sbi soem ba ki por pyrem ki sbait pynloog ka jiog* tong dobkba paitbab ba Umdao (Isbamsty). Barob ki Sarnia, ki Tymmen bad ki kbyooab ki ju leit lut sba* ta ia ka ban tone dobkba, lait sa tang katto katne ogut ki kyntbei bad ki kbyooab ki sab ba sbnong. Sbisico ba kawei ka por, la jia katba ki raogbah bad ki paitbab ka sbooog barob ki dang ia don kyrbai ba Undaa. Kyndit kyodit la poi ki noagsyotiat osei- re • natd karud noog kaba ki khot ka Lad Mawkben. Ha kaa« ka por, la mib kawei ka kyntbei kaba shlor bed ka la tor ibapbrang, da ka bait joag ka ka la KA THMA BAD U HINDU RAM 131 pyobyrogia bad pyosngewbba ia kita ki riew thma da kaba iaaong kwai bad iatbuh khaoa biria. Hadieo kata ka la oog ia ki ba km la ap shippr ba kao leit pom ala ban siaog ia ki ktanang ba kin iob ia thiab kai bang* ta namar ba sbit tbao ka sngi. Kumta ka la leit pom da ki sla synrem bal ka la siaog ba kin ia tbiab kai bangta. Ka la ong rub ia ki ba kin la tbiab kai bad ap ia ka ba kao leit shim jingbam ia ki. Kioe ki myn* der namar ba kim ju itbub ia u synrem uba kamno^ yoda la dap sbipbaog ki la ia sdang ban trud met oa> mar ba dait buid bad ba btiar. Kumoe katba ki naog ia ap ia ka ki la pisa jiogmut sbibuo eb namar ka jiog- btiar bad at bylliaog ka met ka pbad barob sbirynieog, pbewse kim tip satia ba dait u rem-la-bab.

Kane ka kyntbei basbiur ka la leit kiew badnb ban da poi ba kliar U Mawpaloog, u maw uba beb bad bdjroog tarn uba don bajao u Mawsfiiub ne Mawoguid briew ba kblieb Mawlong. Ka la pyrta jam katba kot la ka bor ia kita ki noogtong-dohkba ha Umdan. K« la kbot. *‘Ko Ranglapom ka Hima Mawlong. march bran bran ki ooogsbuo ki la wan tur ba kbyrdep sbaopp'*. Kaba pbylla ka long kumoo ba kita ki brieW ki la iob angew ia ka jingpyrta Jong ka, kaba ka jiogjogai jong kata ka jaka ka long kumba 10 kilometre. Knmta kiln ki rangiapom sbisyodoo ki la iehnob ia la ki jar, ki dobkha, ki tiar ki tar, ki kyntbei khynoab bad kfaaladom tang sfai khyllipftat ki la poi ba sbnong. Kine ki rang* iapom ki la lap ia kita ki noogshuo ba ki dang in trad bad ia kyrshut met ialade da ka jingkbnium badjing^ dait boiat bym lah oog sbub. Ha kata bi ka kbyliip mat ki rangiapom ki la khrai kblieb ia kita ki noogsbua nwei pa awei hadoh ban da lot kboit. Ka thma bad U Hindu Raja t— Mynhyodcl, |7 HIin do Rgja 0 la long u syiem vba kbraw bad ba*do«niiii abibon eh ha ki tbain ri dkhar. U la long a Syiem nba don ka it ka bima kaba iar bad o phnd n pyrton nba kblaln. Ki briew jong n bad ki kbon ki bajar ka ItNia Mawlong ki jir ia kbaii^pateog bad iadl# latidad ha« [ 4 ] KA THMA BAD U HINDU RAJA pdeog jong kl ba ki bat kiba don ba kbappud. Hynrel booaieo kloe ki Noog Mawloog namar ba ki kwab ban iar o pud o sam ki ja leit sha ri dkbar ban lute bad dokbol ia ki mar ki mata joog ki dkbar bad ki wau- rab ka spab ka bajar kaba kbraw sha la bima. Kaoe ka jingleb jong ki ka la .pynbitar sbibun ia uoe u Syiem bakbraw. Ha kaaei ba sngi, u Hindu Raja u la biar thma kyndit kyndtt ia ka hima Mawlong bad u la wan> fab da ka Lieng Tama badub Kurikbar.

Ki Mawloog ba kata ka por ki don ka kut kaba kblain ba Noogkdait. Ki riewkieog Stieb baroh ki don kumba 400 ngut aotad kiba kyosai. Don ki kharal, ki kbyrdop, ki kynrob, ki kynton bad u lum Ktong u la long u lum uba bit ch bao khmih syntiat ba ioh wan ki noogshun ban khyilep ia ka shnong. Na uoe u lum iobi lut baroh sawdoog bad ki ju ap pbira ba ka por thma. Ha kata ka por u Hindu Raja bad la u jong u pbud u pyrton u la wan hiar ryngkew badub Kurikbar. U la hukuffl ia ki shipai jong u bao tur beit sba shnong Noogkdait bad bao pyojot la ka kut baskhem jong ki tang da ki kbyllipmat. U la bukum rub ia ki ba kin lute bad waorab lut ia ka spah ka bajar kat kaba ioh. Ia lade pat u la shoog hapob log Lieng Tama, u da ap kbmib lynti ia ka khubor ba-bba. Hynrei kane ka jiogapkbmih lyoti joog u ka la long da kbongpoog. Ki- na ki rang dajied joog ka bima Mawloog, ki la da rieh Ipa ialade ba kawei ka krem ba Keilatam ban khyr* dep la ki noogshun yoda ki la jam sba kbmat. Kum- ta kita ki shipai U Hindu Raja ki la poi ngong ba kata ka por, kim sbym la pol pyrkbat eiei ba don briew ha kata ka jaka bad ki la nangiaid sba kbmat. Kioe kl riewkieog stieb ki la shu peit syntiat ia ka jiogiaid jong ki, ynda baba ki ia poi ba lynti khim, ki la ia nib lut oapoh krem. Ki la pyllait nambrap da ki Nam* pliaog oadien joog kita ki sbipat U Hindu Raja kat badub ba ki la kyllon iip barob bad la iait Im sa tabg uwei. Hadieo kata kua ka kput kylliaog, ki la abla bad ot lut ia ki myaraln jong kita ki dkbar ba la iap bad KA KHLAM BAKHRAW HA KONGKDAIT {51 ki la suk kyndaog kum ki kpieog da ki Iwtr haduh kbyodai kvodaog bad kt aa pyodeog ba ka ryrdaog jong uta u«ei u dkbar oba im.

Ki la leit on ia uta a dkbar bad da ka jingrisa jtngkyoboi artad«artad lynti haduh ban da poi ha ka Lieng Tama U Hindu Raja. U Hindu Raja u tang ahu iob) ia kata, u la tap la la ka khmat da ka kti namar ka jiogsngew jab burom kaba khraw. U la iam ktbang iaiade bapoh kata ka Lieng. Ki rang* lapom jong ka Hima Miwlong, ki la nang pynjur ka jingrisa jingkynboi, ki la byntbiew la kyrkbah, don na pdet g jong kl k'ba la kawang da ki maw bad siat kai da ki kbnam la kata ka Lieng Tama Hadien kata, kl ia bukum ia u Hindu Raja b id ia uta u Shipai uba kit khyndai kyndang ^a ka ryndang jong u ban mih nob na ka Lieng Tama bad ban le't pbai pat aha la ka bima U Hindu Raja da ka jingsbeptieng kaba kbraw bad da ka jingsngew jab burom artad, u la shim da ka lieng kynda bad u la leit pbai sba la ka hima. Hyn* rei ynd^ la poi ba Cbattak bamar shi'eog duriaw u la pynnganb ia ka lieng jong u. bad barob ar ngut ki U lap jyllop. Ka lieng tama jong u ka la sabkut ba Ku* nkbar bad badub mynta ka don kawel ka pyntha ka* ba ki kbot ka Pyotba-liengtama U Hindu Raja. 3 Ka Khlam bakhraw ha Nongkdait : — Kane ka jing* ieh ki Nong Mawlong ia U Hindp Raja ka la pyn* sngewsih badub katta jcatta ia ki blei. Ki blei ki la ia shoDg do b’lr bad ki la ia pyrkhat kumno ban pynsbi* tom bed ai $«ja ia ki Mawlong namar ka jingleb be*i>jot ia U Hindu Raja. Ha kata ka por la mib ka Khlam bad ka la kuiar ban shimti ma ka ia kare ka kam. Kum* ta ba kawei ka sogi. ka Kbiam ka la wan k’cw ba Lum Ktong bad ka la kylla masi iaiade bangta. Ka la long ka masi samla kaba sngaid bad ba itynoad bha. Nangta na Lum Ktong ka ia ipng sbyeng, ka la pbai khmat aha Nongkdait bad ka da pab artad bo-sbi*!^. Ki Rabg* bab Nongkdait ki la la lyngbgob, ka masi jongpo aba kaba wan pab bangta 7 Kumta uyvei napdeng ki rang* bah u la kit bran • bran ban kbmih ia kata kg Ade'% u la oag, '*Ka masi jongno kane kaba wan poi [ 6 ] KA KHLAM BAKHRAW HA NONGKDAIT hangoe, kaba sogaid bad ba ityonad bba?” Kumta hi a la pyrta ia la ki lok bad u la khot ia ki ba kin wao ia beh ahata Sbisyodoo, u paidbab ka sbaong u la ia khih tik ban la beh thong la kata ka masi.

Kata ka icasi ka tang sbu iobsngew ia ka sur u paidbah ka la her iap oangta. U paidbah bid ki sew behmrad, ki la ia tbwet bad beh ia kata ka masi badub ban da lap ia ka. Kumta uwei u brie# u la lap ia ka ba ka kyndoig kaba bit, u la 'pyllait shi khnam bad ka la kyl- loo artad. Yoda ki paidbab ki la ia poi ki la ia kmen la ia risa ka bym lab ong sbuh Ki la ia pom dieng pom jyrmie ban thaw kroog bad ki la ia bah oam la kata ka masi kylleog ka sbcong ka thaw bad ki da ia pbawar rub artad. Kumta ki br^ew baroh shi-sboong ki la ia mib lut ban ia bam kbana sbnoog ia kata ka masi. Ka sbnoog Noogkdait baroh kawei ka la dap da ka jingsagewbha bad jiogshad kmso ha kata hi ka sogi. Kane ka jiogbam koaoa shoong ka la long kaba sbit- rbem badub katta katta. Yoda la dtp kata ka jiogia* bam-iadib sngewbha badub ka por miet, ka kblam (Cho- lera) ka la sding bin trei kam ia iwei pa iwei. La ong ba ka fiogiap ka la long kaba sbyrkhei sbibuo bad ym shym don maoo m«oo sbub ba oud baqlelt tor shata. Kaoe ka jiogjia ka la long kabi sogew paognud sbibuo, baroh ki briew ba sbnoog ki ia iap lut pbar. Ka sbnoog ka la long kaba i-kynjib bad ba i-ogiew badub katta katta.
